Epi and Didge — installing on Windows
=====================================

Copy each format you want into its folder. The same paths apply to both
plugins.

  Epi.vst3   ->  C:\Program Files\Common Files\VST3\
  Epi.clap   ->  C:\Program Files\Common Files\CLAP\
  Epi.exe    ->  anywhere; it runs on its own, no host needed

Then restart your host so it rescans. The builds are unsigned; SmartScreen
may ask once before the standalone first runs.
